title: 冻结实验输入并公平执行基线和候选

verification_commands.meaning: the plan-declared selector for this card, run for the record: it refuses to route, which is why a key inside this card's write_scope was registered

alternatives_considered: append W10-01 to the legacy selector list: dispatch would then run ops/ci/experiments.py, a program this card may not edit, whose output has no W10-01 routing, so the card would be graded by a roster belonging to W10-G01

add a v2.4 key also named test.experiments: dispatch.py resolves keys exactly and prefers v2.4 when the key exists there, so this would shadow the legacy entry for the accepted parent gates W10-G01/W10-G02/W08-G01
leave the card unbound: the plan says an unbound command is not a PASS, and this card's checks would then have no reproducible entry point

blast_radius_measured.method: each entry serialised with sort_keys=True and compared against git show HEAD:execution/v2.4/commands.json

not_exercised_with_reason.reason: observing them needs a suite that exits non-zero while still emitting green rows, i.e. a fabricated emitter rather than a mutation of delivered code. M02-M06 show the underlying suites do go red when the product changes.
needs an id emitted by the run but not declared in the source, which can only be produced by injecting a test rather than mutating one; left for the reviewer to attempt directly.

not in this card's write_scope. Mutating another card's delivered file to prove my own check risks leaving bytes I do not own mutated if this loop dies mid-iteration, which is the recorded incident class for this project.
frozen contract owned by another card; this card's limits forbid changing it.

mutation_matrix.completeness_claim: Every mutant run is listed, and every one that did not behave as expected is in problems. This is not a claim that the suites are fully covered: the four entries in not_exercised_with_reason are reachable behaviour I did not falsify.

coverage_map.witnesses: 35 of 35 claim regexes resolved to path:line at build time
coverage_map.withdrawn_row: the map's first still-owed row claimed the paired run discards the arm's stderr; it does not - the whole sandbox receipt is marshalled into the execution body and sealed inside native-runtime.json

verdict_taxonomy_as_delivered.decision: INVALID is kept on integrity_status; the frozen verdict enum is not widened. The frozen input agrees: PF-11 carries expected_handling INVALID while PF-12 carries MISSING, and the adapter's own whitelist enumerates the five verdicts.
verdict_taxonomy_as_delivered.residual_characterised: the paired runner maps case verdicts to 1/0/nil, so ERROR, ABSTAIN and MISSING are not distinguishable inside a metric observation even though each arm's sealed evaluation report keeps them. Changing that needs the observation shape, which this card does not own; recorded, not silently repaired.

mid_card_failure_disclosed: the handler built its child environment dict but never passed env= to subprocess.run, silently dropping RESEARCHOS_GO and losing the five A07-NATIVE rows; deterministic, found by making each suite report its own go failure output

the first registry entry set assertion_field to assertions, which dispatch.py reserves for the integer count, so the bound dispatch returned INVALID_ASSERTION_REPORT exit 9 with 123 rows collected; fixed on both sides and recorded in selector_registration_round1.json
register_w1001_selector.py raised KeyError after os.replace had already written registry rev 23, leaving the write sound but its after-side evidence missing; a follow-up verifier produced it

mid_card_failure_disclosed.what: three of the four coverage-map draft quotes and one absence row were wrong before the map was frozen; a fourth wrongness (the stderr row) survived into the frozen map and was withdrawn by a correction file
mid_card_failure_disclosed.fix: the map was rebuilt so each claim is a regex resolved against disk, and the withdrawn row is carried in w1001_coverage_map_correction_round1.json rather than edited in place
mid_card_failure_disclosed.retry_count: 0 - the artifact changed each time; no identical input was retried

resource_gaps.gap: W05 live runtime qualification is unavailable, so ExecuteExperimentPair refuses any experiment whose measurement_mode is not FIXTURE with 503 RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE
resource_gaps.effect: action 2's real baseline/candidate execution is witnessed in FIXTURE mode only; this receipt records mode=FIXTURE and does not claim a LIVE paired run
resource_gaps.unlock_condition: the W05 live runtime card supplies a registered native tool and a LIVE measurement_mode run

resource_gaps.gap: C05 and C07 are listed as affected formal cases but are not emitted by this key
resource_gaps.effect: the selector declares case_id [A07] only, so a C05 or C07 dispatch on this key refuses rather than borrowing A07's roster
resource_gaps.note: formal cases are signed by their own owners, not by this card

limits_respected.retry_policy: no identical-input retry was used; each re-run followed a change
limits_respected.targeted_repairs: 0 of 1 spent on the bound route; the two pre-bind defects were fixed before the first bound run
limits_respected.frozen_evidence: no already-hashed evidence file was edited; corrections are new files
